title: Users
description: The people who sign in to StockFlow, their roles and their access.

created.title: User created
created.description: Share this temporary password with {{name}}. It is shown only now; they must change it when they sign in.

reset.title: Password reset
reset.description: The new temporary password of {{name}}. It is shown only now; their sessions were ended.

confirm.resetPassword: A new temporary password will be generated for {{name}}, and their sessions will end.
confirm.deactivate: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in, and their sessions will end.
confirm.reactivate: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.

access.title: Access of {{name}}
access.exceptionsDescription: An exception replaces what the roles give for one permission, until it expires. It needs a reason.
